<article title="Refund timelines">
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days after the return arrives at our warehouse. Your bank may take a further three to ten business days to show the credit on your statement.

If you chose store credit, it appears in your account as soon as the return is checked in, usually the same day.

If more than 15 business days have passed since the carrier delivered your return to us and no refund has appeared, contact us with your order number and we will check the return with our warehouse.

Customer first name: Kwabena
<request>
refund timing
the carrier says my return was delivered to you yesterday. when does the money come back?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Kwabena,

Thanks for contacting us! Once your return arrives at our warehouse, refunds to your original payment method are issued within five business days. After that, your bank may take an additional three to ten business days to display the credit on your statement.

If you selected store credit instead, it will appear in your account as soon as the return is checked in—typically the same day.

If more than 15 business days pass without a refund appearing, please reach out with your order number and we'll investigate with our warehouse.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
